Fellow Residents:
At this time of year we especially recognize our Veterans
and thank them for the service they have provided to our
country and the service they continually provide to our
community.
Members of the American Legion Post 234 and the VFW
Post 9520 can be seen at many events throughout the year -
- from raising the flag at football games and our
annual Trike & Bike event, to bringing the flag etiquette
program into all fifth grade classes. They organize the
annual Memorial Day program and parade, and are present
at numerous services and ceremonies throughout the year.
You are invited to show your appreciation at the
Veterans Day ceremony that will be held on Wednesday,
November 11, 2026, at 11:00am, in Council Chambers
at Brunswick City Hall.
Please always remember to thank a Veteran.
Respectfully,
Carl S. DeForest, City Manager

Thank you to Superintendent Jason
Niedermeyer, the school principals, the
students and families for the extra effort
in making this year’s Trike & Bike event
bigger and better than ever. We had over 390 young riders
participate and raised over $89,000. All money is used for
pediatric cancer research at Cleveland Clinic Children’s.
Thank you to the many young riders who are making a difference
in the fight against cancer.
